_about: Deep-dive sites in Egypt's Western Desert. Kamil Crater's position is from the 2011 Geology paper (22°01'06"N, 26°05'15"E); the rest are APPROXIMATE centres to refine on a map before cutting high-resolution tiles.

sites.name: Kharga Depression
sites.note: Yardangs, dune trains, wind-cut channels (USGS field studies, 1984)

sites.name: Kamil Crater
sites.note: 45 m rayed impact crater, about 5,000 years old; needs imagery or a 30 m DEM, too small for 463 m tiles

sites.name: Gilf Kebir plateau
sites.note: Fluvial and wind erosion studied in the 1978 expedition

sites.name: Great Sand Sea
sites.note: Dune belts compared with Viking images of Martian dunes

sites.name: Black Desert
sites.note: Dark basalt-capped hills; check before using
